title: Samuel's Victory at Mizpah (Ebenezer)
summary: Twenty years after the Ark came to Kirjath-jearim, Israel repents at Mizpah and the LORD thunders on the Philistines; Samuel sets up Ebenezer and the Philistines "came no more into the coast of Israel" (1 Sam 7:2–14).
description: Judges-period record added from James B. Jordan's chronology (secondary display) with Ussher, Jones and, where available, CFAH-1 Table 1 dates for sorting. Jordan treats the judgeships as partly overlapping regional sequences (North / Centre / South) fitted to the 480 years of 1 Kgs 6:1 and the 300 years of Judg 11:26.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (F. N. Jones): 1101 BC (no higher-tier year available). Jordan (secondary display) never sets the sort.

chronologies.date: "BC 1101 is established ... as the year of Samson's death and Samuel's signal victory over the Philistines"
chronologies.citation: Jones, Chronology of the Old Testament (15th ed., 2002), ch. V "Chart Four", p. 86
chronologies.note: Chart No. 4: Philistine dominion 1141–1101 BC; Ark at Kirjath-jearim 1121–1101 BC.

chronologies.date: 2908c AM, 1096 BC (after 20 years, Israel gathers at Mizpah and the Philistines are routed)
chronologies.citation: Ussher, Annals of the World, Fourth Age §390 (paragraph numbering of the modern transcription)

chronologies.date: "2901 - Death of Samson, battle of Mizpah, deliverance from Philistine oppression."
chronologies.citation: Jordan, From Creation to Solomon (Studies in Biblical Chronology No. 2, Biblical Horizons, Oct. 2001), ch. 11 "The Era of the Judges and the Reign of Saul", p. 52
chronologies.note: 2001 revision. Jordan's 1991 list (BC 3:8) has an earlier year; see the second Jordan entry.

chronologies.date: "2875 - Death of Samson, battle of Mizpah, deliverance from Philistine oppression."
chronologies.citation: Jordan, "Chronology and Kings (II)," Biblical Chronology 3:8 (August 1991), section "The Judges", summary list
chronologies.note: 1991 scheme, superseded by Jordan himself in 2001 (Studies in Biblical Chronology No. 2 dates the whole judges sequence 26 years later because he there ends the 300 years of Judg 11:26 when Ammon took the villages, AM 2860, not at Jephthah's victory). BC 3:7 (July 1991), "Saul in Context": the battle of Mizpah came "in the year Samuel died [sic: as printed] and right at the time Elon the Zebulunite, the northern judge, also died".

chronologies.date: Death of Samson, at 40 yrs old. And the Battle of Mizpah. (16:31, I Sam.7) 2901 AM
chronologies.citation: Anno Mundi Chronology Studies (unnamed compiler; a compilation of James B. Jordan's system), p. 8, chart "Year of the World: From the Judges to King Saul (Chronology from James Jordan)"
chronologies.note: Agrees with Jordan's own published AM 2901.
